statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-41316 (GHSA-q339-8rmv-2mhv): in the Ruby erb library, ERB#def_method, and through it #def_module and #def_class, evaluates the template source without the initialization check that ERB#result and #run perform, so an ERB object rebuilt by Marshal.load from untrusted data can be used to run code: https://github.com/ruby/erb/security/advisories/GHSA-q339-8rmv-2mhv, https://www.ruby-lang.org/en/news/2026/04/21/erb-cve-2026-41316. It is fixed in erb 6.0.1.1 (and 4.0.3.1, 4.0.4.1, 6.0.4) by commit https://github.com/ruby/erb/commit/dd34ce41031327269a5fb83b0bc2c0d852895e9f, which makes def_method raise 'not initialized' unless the object was created by ERB.new. Ruby 4.0.1 and 4.0.2 bundle erb 6.0.1, Ruby 4.0.3 to 4.0.6 bundle 6.0.1.1 and Ruby 4.0.7 and later bundle 6.0.7 (lib/erb/version.rb at those tags). The DHI ruby-4.0 package for Alpine 3.23 is published as 4.0.1-r0, 4.0.1-r1, 4.0.2-r1, 4.0.2-r2, 4.0.3-r2, 4.0.4-r2, 4.0.4-r3, 4.0.5-r3, 4.0.6-r3, 4.0.6-r4, 4.0.7-r4, 4.0.9-r4, 4.0.10-r4 and 4.0.10-r5, for x86_64 and aarch64. We downloaded every package built from the ruby-4.0 source in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository as published on 2026-11-28, 654 package files across both architectures, checked each against its repository index checksum and listed every file in them. The erb library ships in ruby-4.0-libs (usr/lib/ruby/4.0.0/erb.rb and usr/lib/ruby/4.0.0/erb/); ruby-4.0 carries only the usr/bin/erb command that loads it, and ruby4.0-rbs only a type signature. In ruby-4.0-libs 4.0.1-r0, 4.0.1-r1, 4.0.2-r1 and 4.0.2-r2, erb.rb is identical to lib/erb.rb at the Ruby v4.0.2 tag, erb 6.0.1, and def_method has no initialization check. In 4.0.3-r2 through 4.0.6-r4 it is identical to lib/erb.rb at v4.0.3, erb 6.0.1.1, and def_method checks @_init before evaluating; in 4.0.7-r4 and every later build it is identical to lib/erb.rb at v4.0.7, erb 6.0.7, and def_method makes the same check through initialized_by_new?. Both architectures agree for every build. The range is introduced at the first published build and fixed at 4.0.3-r2, the first build with the check.
